pageHeadHtml:
Grants & Funding

Principal Investigator or Ashoka lead on several competitively funded clinical AI programmes, and Clinical/Technical Team Supervisor on two Gates Foundation-supported programmes with combined official commitments of ~US$1.36 million (linked below).
pageBodyHtml:
• 2026 — DST–A*STAR India-Singapore Joint Science and Technology Research Programme, ~₹2.5 crore, Principal Investigator. Three-year programme on indigenous datasets and culturally congruent radiology vision-language models. — Announcement
  • 2026 — ANRF Advanced Research Grant, coronary artery disease risk stratification, Honorary Investigator and Lead (Ashoka). Amount pending public confirmation.
  • 2026 — IndiaAI Cancer AI and Technology Challenge (CATCH), PREDICT-AI, ~₹50 lakh, Principal Investigator. Consortium with KCDH-A, Tata Memorial Hospital, and Manentia AI. — Announcement
  • 2025 — Gates Foundation-supported PrAImaan programme, US$972,192 formal commitment, Clinical Research and Technical Teams Supervisor (PI: Prof. Anurag Agrawal). — Grant record
  • 2025 — Gates Foundation-supported V2DD programme, US$383,295 formal commitment, Clinical Evaluation Team Supervisor (PI: Prof. Anurag Agrawal). — Grant record
  • 2025 — Simons Foundation support to Ashoka University — Simons Ashoka Early Career Fellowship (full-time fellowship).
  • 2022–2025 — TIH iHub Drishti (AIIMS Delhi × IIT Jodhpur), Rib Fracture AI Project, ~₹39 lakh, Investigator (MD thesis project). Produced AIRib, the RSNA Trainee Research Prize 2023, and the MICCAI 2025 paper. — iHub Drishti
  • DBT (Department of Biotechnology) — Lung Cancer Response Prediction (project protocol). — DBT India
  • 2018 — ICMR Short-Term Studentship — normative data for arterial stiffness indices, JIPMER, Student Investigator. — ICMR STS
